title: 第1279章 大帝之姿第1278章 神仙打架
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
太徽剑宗。
大帝之姿拥有者，中州源初圣地圣君玄觞面色阴沉。
这个世界的修士当真是废物！
连一个被重伤垂死的小丫头都擒拿不住。
若非他也身受重伤，焉能如此被动？
世间所有事，迟则生变。左右这些时日他的伤势已经恢复七八，还是他亲自走一趟才妥当。
“宗主，长老。”玄觞起身道，“此事本就应该由本君亲手了结，那妖女狡诈，夺我至宝，害我身受重伤。这些时日，本君功体已恢复大半，看来还是本君亲自走一趟才好。”
大长老闻言，立刻说道：“天人莫急，待我们摸清那妖女下落，天人再亲手操刀也不迟。”
玄觞迟疑片刻，默默颔首，“也好。”
另一边，万脊山脉外围五十里，据守边境小镇的凌云府修士亲眼目睹万脊山脉恐怖动静，俱是被吓得魂不附体。
“出事了，出事了！速速回禀宗门，万脊山脉深处应该是有皇级大妖厮杀，数量怕是不在少数，极有可能会引发大规模兽潮冲出山脉！”
“快，火速离开！”
消息被送至凌云府，顿时炸开了锅。
万脊山脉皇级大妖大规模厮杀，怕是又要在天灵大陆掀起一阵腥风血雨！
“速速知会太徽剑宗、长生谷！”凌云府一众长老惊惧道，“叫他们一起共商对策！”
可紧接着，又有消息被送到凌云府。据守小镇的宗门弟子面色诡异，迷惑不解道：“万脊山脉外被人砍出了一条绵延近千里的巨大沟壑，那些暴动的妖兽被堵在沟壑那头，只有极少数飞了出来，祸乱边镇！”
“什么！？”
凌云府掌权者俱是摸不着头脑。
而与此同时，最疯狂的还得是长生谷。那一日，天灵大陆天幕之上，两道光辉自皓月上来，所有目睹此景之人尽皆瞠目。
太徽剑宗最先动作，探明那两道光辉不是所谓的大帝帝兵出世，而是两个天外来人！

据太徽剑宗放出的消息，其中一人有大帝之姿，已经被请回宗门，奉为上宾。而另一个，乃是一个“妖女”。
那妖女设计偷取天人至宝养剑葫，害得天人重伤。天人愤怒至极，追杀妖女至此，誓要将其挫骨扬灰！
而此时此刻，那妖女就在长生谷！
长生谷前任谷主蔺浔数年前只身前往万脊山脉采药，试图炼出品阶更高的长生丹延续寿元，数年来音讯全无，若非其魂灯未灭，长生谷上下皆以为他早已葬身万脊山脉。
可谁曾想就在三日前，前谷主蔺浔突然回到宗门，还带着一个身受重伤，气息奄奄的貌美女子。
原本长生谷一众修士并未将那女子往“妖女”身上想，可就在两天后，太徽剑宗发布悬赏，向天灵大陆各大宗门传递消息，消息内容便是一纸画像，声称凡有人能提供妖女踪迹，可得太徽剑宗一把上品飞剑，家中后辈若有愿意拜入太徽剑宗的，可以直接进入外门修行，若是根骨奇佳，甚至可以不经过选拔，直接进入内门修行！
悬赏一经传开，长生谷炸锅了。
画像上的妖女，和老谷主蔺浔带回来的那女子一模一样！
“老谷主，我长生谷明面上和太徽剑宗齐名，可到底差距有多大，您老还不清楚吗！”现任谷主集结了一帮长老、管事将蔺浔堵在雁回峰上，面容愁苦，“他们都说太徽剑宗那位天人有大帝之姿，此等人物，哪里是我们能够得罪的？”
“老谷主，假以时日那位天人在天灵大陆证道成帝，我等如今的作为，到那时哪里还有我长生谷的活路？”
“退一万步来说，太徽剑宗我们也不好与之为敌啊！”
人群嘈杂。
蔺浔内心烦躁，厉声斥责道：“既然都是从天上下来的，为何他就一定是天人，老夫救回来的就一定是妖女？”
“老谷主说的对，他太徽剑宗有大帝之姿，我长生谷为何不能有！”
“我看仙子才是天人，太徽剑宗那个定是妖男，颠倒黑白！”
content_en:
Taihui Sword Sect.
The possessor of the posture of the Great Emperor, the Holy Lord Xuan Zhang of the Yuanchu Holy Land in Zhongzhou looked gloomy.
The monks in this world are really useless!
He couldn't even capture a little girl who was seriously injured and dying.
If he hadn't been seriously injured, how could he be so passive?
Everything in the world will change sooner or later. In the past few days, he has recovered from his injuries, so it would be better for him to go there in person.
"Sect Master, Elder." Xuan Zang stood up and said, "This matter should have been settled by me personally. The witch was cunning and took away my treasure, causing me to be seriously injured. In the past few days, I have recovered more than half of my strength. It seems that it is best for me to go there myself."
Upon hearing this, the Great Elder immediately said: "Gods, don't be anxious. When we find out the whereabouts of the demon girl, it won't be too late for Gods to take action with their own hands."
Xuanzang hesitated for a moment, then nodded silently, "That's fine."
On the other side, fifty miles outside the Wanji Mountains, the monks from the Lingyun Mansion guarding the border town witnessed the terrifying movements in the Wanji Mountains with their own eyes, and they were all frightened out of their wits.
"Something happened, something happened! Report to the sect quickly. There should be emperor-level demons fighting in the depths of the Ten Thousand Ridges Mountains. The number is probably not small, and it is very likely that a large-scale beast tide will rush out of the mountains!"
"Quick, leave quickly!"
The news was sent to Lingyun Mansion, and the situation immediately exploded.
The large-scale killing of the emperor-level monsters in the Ten Thousand Ridges Mountains is likely to cause another bloody storm in the Tianling Continent!
"Inform Taihui Sword Sect and Changsheng Valley immediately!" The elders of Lingyun Mansion said in fear, "Ask them to discuss countermeasures together!"
But then, another news was sent to Lingyun Mansion. The sect disciples guarding the town looked strange and said in confusion: "A huge ravine stretching nearly a thousand miles was cut outside the Wanji Mountains. The rioting monsters were blocked at the other end of the ravine. Only a few flew out and caused trouble in the border town!"
"What!?"
The people in power in Lingyun Mansion were all confused.
At the same time, the craziest thing is the Valley of Eternal Life. That day, above the sky of Tianling Continent, two rays of light came up from the bright moon. Everyone who witnessed this scene was stunned.
The Taihui Sword Sect was the first to take action and found out that the two rays of light were not the so-called Great Emperor's soldiers, but two outsiders!
According to the news released by Taihui Sword Sect, one of them has the appearance of a great emperor and has been invited back to the sect as an honored guest. And the other one is a "witch".
The witch designed to steal the treasure of heaven and man to raise the sword gourd, causing the heaven and man to be seriously injured. The heavenly man was so angry that he chased the demon girl to this point and vowed to crush her to ashes!
At this moment, the witch is in the Valley of Immortality!
Lin Xun, the former owner of the Immortality Valley, went to the Ten Thousand Ridges Mountains to collect herbs several years ago, trying to refine a higher-grade Immortality Pill to extend his longevity. There has been no news for several years. If his soul lamp had not been extinguished, everyone in the Immortality Valley thought he had been buried in the Ten Thousand Ridges Mountains.
But who would have thought that just three days ago, the former Valley Master Lin Xun suddenly returned to the sect, bringing with him a beautiful woman who was seriously injured and dying.
Originally, the monks in the Eternal Life Valley did not think of the woman as a "witch", but just two days later, the Taihui Sword Sect issued a reward and sent a message to all the major sects in the Tianling Continent. The content of the message was a portrait, claiming that anyone who could provide traces of the witch would be given a high-grade flying sword by the Taihui Sword Sect. If the family members are willing to join the Taihui Sword Sect, they can directly enter the outer sect to practice. If they have excellent bones, they can even directly enter the inner sect to practice without being selected!
Once word spread about the reward, the Valley of Immortality exploded.
The witch in the portrait is exactly the same as the woman brought back by the old Valley Master Lin Xun!
"Old Valley Master, I am as famous as the Taihui Sword Sect in the Changsheng Valley, but don't you know how big the difference is!" The current Valley Master gathered a group of elders and stewards to block Lin Xun on the Yanhui Peak, with a sad face, "They all say that the Taihui Sword Sect's heavenly man has the appearance of a great emperor. How can we offend such a person?"
"Old Valley Master, let's pretendAt that time, when that heavenly being attained enlightenment and became the emperor in Tianling Continent, what we are doing now, how can I still have a way to survive in the Valley of Immortality by then? "
"Taking a step back, we can't be enemies with the Taihui Sword Sect! "
The crowd was noisy.
Lin Xun was irritable in his heart and reprimanded sternly: "Since they all came down from the sky, why must he be a heavenly being, and the one I rescued must be a witch? "
"The old Valley Master is right, his Taihui Sword Sect has the appearance of a great emperor, why can't I, the Immortal Valley, have that! "
"I think fairies are heavenly beings, and the one from Taihui Sword Sect must be a demon man, confusing right and wrong! "
